summary: Product roadmap authority: milestones are strictly ordered and DONE only when every exit criterion passes live in a real install, not when tickets close. Status as of 2026-07-09: M0 Foundation and M1 Converter jewels DONE at v0.1; character-card forge CLOSED; Media jewel largely landed; Lorebook studio jewel planned next; Risu Workshop jewel DONE; Studio usable ahead of formal M6 packaging. Character-card forge closed platforms include SillyTavern Default CCv3, RoleCall, Backyard, Agnai, Pygmalion, Lumiverse, Marinara schema, Chub, Risu Workshop; Character.AI dropped, Crushon skipped, Janitor thin defer, NovelAI not a character jewel. Studio content types table tracks character, media, lorebook, sprite pack, and regex/persona/preset status. Numbered milestones: M0 and M1 jewel done; M2 Brain, M3 Script Doctor, M4 Table Read, and M7 Archives not started; M5 Test Stage partial with sealed Test Bench but productions open; M6 Studio ahead of plan and usable but packaging not formal DONE. What now recommends content-type editors, sprites media, NovelAI lorebook, M3, M2, packaging polish, then M6 packaging; do not reopen C.AI or Crushon native bags. Ground truth is this file plus M0 and M1 jewel docs.

sections.title: M0 - Foundation
sections.summary: Foundation milestone: repo scaffold with Bun workspace, CI, lint, LICENSE and CLA bot; fixture corpus seeded with at least forty real files across formats; packages/core canonical schemas; escrow envelope; PNG chunk codec; Round-Trip Law harness in CI. Code reality notes engine fixtures and round-trip culture live under src/ as monorepo shape evolved past pure packages; treat effectively green when tsc, bun test, and color and line scans pass. Exit requires bun test green under Bun and Node; a V2 PNG card parses to canonical and round-trips at declared fidelity; CI blocks a deliberately broken round-trip and a deliberately added AGPL dependency. Status: JEWEL DONE as of 2026-07-09.

sections.title: M1 - The Converter (v0.1, first public release)
sections.summary: First public converter release scope: all codecs for V2 V3 JSON PNG, charx, Backyard, ST worldbook, RC lorebook, ST preset, Lumiverse preset, personas, regex scripts; content-type detection; vaud convert inspect validate import --bundle export --all-formats; honest conversion reports; single-exe builds checksums and vaud upgrade; README and auto-generated format-support matrix. Code reality: strong ST Risu BYAF Agnai Pygmalion Lumi paths exist; CLI public packaging and full matrix were formal exit items; Studio convert export dialog covers most M1 intent. Exit: mixed ZIP from five platforms converts both ways with zero same-format data loss; binaries on win mac linux; stranger converts a card from GitHub in under three minutes. Status: JEWEL DONE 2026-07-09 for convert inspect validate formats multi-platform smoke matrix and CLI compile; GitHub multi-OS Releases and vaud upgrade remain packaging polish not jewel blockers.

sections.title: M2 - The Brain
sections.summary: Planned agent milestone, NOT STARTED. packages/ai for providers, streaming, weak-model tool fallback, and key vault built on the Vercel AI SDK without a forked agent base. packages/agent for loop, resource tools over vaud://, spill store, staged edits, and personas implementing ADR-006 as product code. Includes vaud bare REPL and agent eval harness with golden tasks. Exit: REPL performs a staged multi-file edit on a production via a frontier model and via a local 7-8B model; eval harness reports success-rate and tokens-per-task for both. Product still treats BYOK as optional later; convert works offline.

sections.title: M3 - The Script Doctor (v0.2)
sections.summary: Planned Script Doctor milestone, NOT STARTED though specs exist under specs/features/. Scope includes deterministic passes for format errors, token waste, contradiction candidates, slop banks, speaks-for-user, and W++ relics; health score; AI treatment planner with fix-by-fix staged approval; vaud doctor plus batch mode and markdown ward reports. Exit: doctor a known-bad public card to health at least 85 with every fix approved individually; deterministic pass runs with no key configured.

sections.title: M4 - The Table Read (v0.3)
sections.summary: Planned interview milestone, NOT STARTED. Interview engine as a UI-agnostic event stream of question, chips, answer, and field-patch events; three tempos Cold Read, Deep Dive, and Rapid Fire; adaptive depth; settings; persona voices; deliverable bundles of card plus starter lorebook plus alt greetings. Exit: Cold Read produces a playable card in under five minutes in the terminal; Deep Dive produces a card that beats a hand-written baseline in a blind vibe-check by the owner.

sections.title: M5 - The Test Stage + Productions (v0.4)
sections.summary: Partial milestone. Planned scope: packages/assembly with full prompt trace, CLI test chat with lorebook activation readout rigging view, productions as workspace folders with manifest, content-addressed history and restore, and library mode. Code reality: Risu Workshop Test Bench runs sealed triggers and scripts as a card-local test stage; full production workspaces and assembly package still open. Exit: edit a card field, replay the same test line, watch output change; vaud history restore recovers a deleted lorebook entry. Status PARTIAL: sealed Test Bench exists; full M5 productions open.

sections.title: M6 - The Studio (v0.5)
sections.summary: Desktop app face planned as Tauri shell over the engine, originally blocked on visual-direction re-exploration while code ran ahead. Code reality: local studio shell already runs via bun run dev and desktop-dev with Workbench, Library, Press, Settings, CSS Workshop, Character Fields, Risu Workshop, and platform native bags. Revised exit: studio is the daily driver for forge and convert; formal Tauri packaging polish and public v0.5 packaging still TBD. Status AHEAD OF PLAN: in progress and usable, not formal DONE until packaging exit.

sections.title: M7 - The Archives + The World Forge (v0.6+)
sections.summary: Later planned milestone, NOT STARTED. Distill-from-logs with per-claim citations and evidence review; world forge with interview-grown worlds, corkboard data model, and continuity desk as a standing Doctor pass over a whole production. Exit: distill a real character from at least twenty thousand words of logs where every field cites real scenes; continuity desk catches a planted cross-file contradiction.

sections.title: What now (recommended order)
sections.summary: With M0 and M1 jewels closed and character cards closed, recommended next order is: full Lorebook and Regex content-type editors to unlock link-outs; Sprites and media milestone Manage Sprites with Lumi and Chub stubs; NovelAI lorebook adapter; M3 Script Doctor deterministic audits without a key; M2 Brain agent loop; packaging polish multi-OS GitHub Releases and vaud upgrade as optional M1 plus; M6 packaging for formal studio release when ready. Do not reopen Character.AI or Crushon native bags. Ground truth is this roadmap file plus M0 and M1 jewel docs.
